next.reason: 1985 refuses a REWRITE where 'Record-name-1 and identifier-1 ... refer to the same storage area'. 2023 has no syntax rule against it: §2023:14.9.35.4 GR7 (NOTE 2) applies 14.6.10 and the MOVE rules 'to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with file-name-1 share any part of their storage areas'; §2023:14.6.10 GR2 makes the same-entry case behave 'as if the data items shared no part' and §2023:14.6.10 GR1 makes other overlap 'undefined'; §2023:14.9.35.4 GR10 contemplates identifier-1 being part of the file's record descriptions. Refusal became acceptance (defined or undefined result); no exception condition.
